name: Mind Lab Pro
summary: The most comprehensively researched nootropic stack available in the EU, priced in EUR on the brand's EU store, which ships EU orders from its depot in Europe. Our #1 pick for European buyers.
whatItIs: Mind Lab Pro is an 11-ingredient nootropic stack made by Opti-Nutra (UK). It is designed as a complete daily cognitive supplement covering memory, focus, mental energy, mood, and long-term brain health. For EU buyers, eu.mindlabpro.com prices in EUR, and its shipping page says EU orders are shipped from the brand's depot in Europe (eu.mindlabpro.com shipping page, checked 2026-10-06). The EU store names Performance Lab Europe Ltd, Dublin (company 698988), as its operator, and its terms make customers ordering from outside the US or UK the Importer of Record for their shipments.
howItWorks: Mind Lab Pro works across six bio-pathways simultaneously. Citicoline and Phosphatidylserine support the cholinergic system and neuronal membrane integrity. Lion's Mane stimulates Nerve Growth Factor (NGF) for neuroplasticity. Bacopa Monnieri enhances synaptic communication for memory. Rhodiola Rosea and L-Tyrosine support dopamine/norepinephrine balance under stress. L-Theanine promotes alpha brain wave activity for calm focus. The EU formula is sold as a food supplement under EU Directive 2002/46/EC, so its label may carry only EU-authorised health claims (assessed by EFSA).
whatToExpect: Within 30-60 minutes: mild calm focus from L-Theanine. Within 2-4 weeks: improved mental energy and reduced cognitive fatigue. At 8-12 weeks: measurable improvements in memory recall and learning speed. EU orders are shipped from the brand's depot in Europe, with an expected delivery time of 4-12 working days depending on destination (eu.mindlabpro.com shipping page, checked 2026-10-06). Mind Lab Pro is a long-game supplement -- most users report subtle but sustained improvement rather than dramatic day-one effects.
pros: Dedicated EU storefront with EUR pricing
cons: Premium price (€65/mo)
2 capsules per serving (2–4 per day suggested)
30-day money-back

name: NooCube
summary: Formula with Lutemax 2020 for screen workers. No EUR storefront: noocube.co.uk sells it at £54.99/mo and does not ship to Germany, France or the Netherlands. Important: the noocube.com Trustpilot profile has no reviews yet -- check the cancellation terms carefully before subscribing.
whatItIs: NooCube is a 12-ingredient nootropic stack from Wolfson Brands. There is no EUR-priced storefront: the UK store (noocube.co.uk) prices in GBP and lists shipping to Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Greece, Croatia, Poland, Sweden and Denmark, but not to Germany, France or the Netherlands. Its standout feature is Lutemax 2020 -- a clinically-studied lutein and zeaxanthin extract that reduces digital eye strain. It is EU Directive 2002/46/EC compliant.
howItWorks: Lutemax 2020 filters high-energy blue light in the retina, reducing the cognitive fatigue that builds up during extended screen use. Choline from VitaCholine (250mg) supports acetylcholine availability; the current formula no longer contains Alpha-GPC or Huperzine A. L-Theanine provides calm focus. Bacopa supports memory consolidation over 8+ weeks.
whatToExpect: Day one: mild calm focus from L-Theanine. Within 2-4 weeks: reduced eye fatigue for screen workers. At 8 weeks: modest memory improvements. The noocube.com Trustpilot profile has no reviews yet -- read the cancellation terms carefully before subscribing.
cons: No reviews on the noocube.com Trustpilot profile (checked 2026-09-28)
Some ingredients underdosed

name: Performance Lab Mind
summary: Opti-Nutra's streamlined 4-ingredient formula. Every ingredient at clinical dose. Only 2 capsules/day. Same manufacturer as Mind Lab Pro.
whatItIs: Performance Lab Mind is a 4-ingredient cognitive supplement from Opti-Nutra -- the same manufacturer as Mind Lab Pro. It is designed as a precision stack where every single ingredient is at or above its clinical trial dose. With only 2 capsules per day, it has the lowest pill burden of any clinically-dosed nootropic in this review.
howItWorks: Citicoline (250mg Cognizin) boosts acetylcholine synthesis and supports neuronal membrane phospholipid production. Phosphatidylserine (100mg Sharp-PS) enhances synaptic signal transduction and reduces cortisol. Lion's Mane (500mg fruiting body) stimulates NGF for long-term neuroplasticity. L-Tyrosine (300mg NALT) replenishes dopamine and norepinephrine precursors for working memory under stress. Each ingredient is at or above the dose used in clinical trials -- no filler, no underdosed compounds.
whatToExpect: Acute (30-60 min): mild focus from Tyrosine and Citicoline's acetylcholine boost. 2-4 weeks: improved mental endurance and reduced cognitive fatigue. 8-12 weeks: memory and neuroprotective benefits from Lion's Mane and Phosphatidylserine accumulate. Performance Lab Mind is ideal as a standalone for minimalists, or stacked with Performance Lab Energy for a comprehensive cognitive + energy protocol.
cons: Narrower formula than MLP
30-day money-back

discontinued.note: Opti-Nutra merged Performance Lab Mind into Mind Lab Pro; the vendor URL now redirects to Mind Lab Pro.

name: BRAINEFFECT FOCUS
summary: BRAINEFFECT FOCUS is a discontinued caffeine-based focus supplement from the Berlin brand BRAINEFFECT. Its product page on brain-effect.com returns 404 and FOCUS no longer appears in the brand's catalogue (checked 2026-09-29). BRAINEFFECT still sells other products, which we have not reviewed. This review is kept for reference; it is not a current recommendation.
whatItIs: BRAINEFFECT FOCUS was a nootropic supplement from BRAINEFFECT, a Berlin-based brand, aimed at the DACH market (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). Its ingredients were permitted under EU food supplement rules, and as an EU food supplement its label could carry only EU-authorised health claims (assessed by the European Food Safety Authority, EFSA), which rules out any caffeine cognition claim: none is authorised in the EU. The product has been discontinued: its brain-effect.com product page returns 404 and it is no longer in the brand's catalogue (checked 2026-09-29).
howItWorks: Panax Ginseng and Ginkgo Biloba were included for circulatory and cognitive support, although neither carries an EU-authorised health claim. Bacopa Monnieri targets memory consolidation. Caffeine (80mg -- equivalent to a small coffee) provides acute focus and alertness. B-vitamins (B6, B12) support energy metabolism and normal psychological function per EU Regulation 1924/2006.
whatToExpect: Acute (30-60 min): focus and alertness from caffeine. 2-4 weeks: improved mental energy and concentration. 8 weeks: modest memory support from Bacopa (note: underdosed at 200mg vs. 300mg clinical threshold).
cons: Contains caffeine
Only 14-day money-back
Lower dosing scores vs. MLP

name: Brainzyme Focus Pro
summary: Natural caffeine from matcha + guarana paired with L-theanine for smooth focus.
whatItIs: Brainzyme Focus Pro is a nootropic supplement using exclusively natural ingredient sources. Its caffeine comes from matcha and guarana rather than synthetic caffeine -- producing a smoother, more sustained focus curve. Brainzyme, operated by Nutraceutical Logistics Global (t/a Brainzyme, Edinburgh), runs separate EUR stores: its international-shipping page directs France, Belgium and Switzerland to brainzyme.fr and Germany, Austria and Switzerland to brainzyme.de, and lists other countries, such as Bulgaria, under rest-of-world shipping from the UK with shipping fees in GBP (brainzyme.com, checked 2026-10-06).
howItWorks: Matcha provides ~40mg natural caffeine plus EGCG (a catechin with mild nootropic properties). Guarana adds ~20mg additional natural caffeine for a total of ~60mg -- lower than coffee but enough for noticeable alertness. L-Theanine (100mg) smooths the caffeine response, reducing jitteriness and extending focus duration. Choline Bitartrate supports acetylcholine synthesis (lower bioavailability than Alpha-GPC but effective at 250mg). B-vitamins support neurological function per EU Regulation 1924/2006.
whatToExpect: Acute (30-45 min): smooth, gradual focus from natural caffeine + L-theanine combination. Less of a spike-and-crash than synthetic caffeine products. 2-4 weeks: sustained daily mental energy. Note: this is primarily a stimulant-based nootropic -- the cognitive enhancement is largely driven by caffeine + theanine synergy. Long-term neuroprotective benefits are limited compared to Citicoline/Bacopa-based stacks.
pros: EUR stores brainzyme.de (ships from Germany) and brainzyme.fr (ships from France), per the brand's shipping pages (checked 2026-10-06)
cons: Contains caffeine
Narrower formula than MLP
Not shipped to Ireland (contains Ginkgo biloba, per the brand's international-shipping page, checked 2026-10-06)

name: Hunter Focus
summary: Premium 9-ingredient UK nootropic. Strong EU presence, well-dosed formula. High pill burden at 6 capsules/day.
whatItIs: Hunter Focus is a premium 9-ingredient nootropic stack from Roar Ambition, a UK supplement brand. It is positioned as a high-performance cognitive supplement for professionals aged 30-50 who want a comprehensive formula covering focus, memory, mood, and mental energy. Priced in EUR on roarambition.com's EU market pages; the shipping policy says orders to Europe ship from the brand's depot in England, and its terms state there are no customs charges for EU customers (roarambition.com, checked 2026-10-06).
howItWorks: Hunter Focus covers multiple cognitive pathways: Lion's Mane (500mg) stimulates NGF for long-term neuroplasticity. Ashwagandha (300mg KSM-66) reduces cortisol and supports cognitive resilience under stress. Phosphatidylserine (100mg) enhances synaptic transmission. ALCAR (500mg) supports brain energy metabolism via mitochondrial function. Caffeine (100mg) + L-Theanine combination provides smooth acute focus. Bacopa Monnieri targets memory consolidation.
whatToExpect: Acute (30-60 min): noticeable focus and motivation boost from caffeine + Ashwagandha combination. 2-4 weeks: better stress resilience and sustained afternoon energy. 8-12 weeks: memory improvements from Bacopa and Lion's Mane accumulate. High pill burden (6 capsules/day) is the most significant practical barrier -- split into two doses of 3 capsules if preferred. Premium price of €85/mo reflects the comprehensive formula.
cons: 6 capsules per serving
Contains caffeine
Premium price (€85/mo)

name: Performance Lab Caffeine 2
summary: A low-dose caffeine capsule from Performance Lab: 50mg natural caffeine with 100mg L-theanine (a 2:1 ratio), 250mg L-tyrosine and four B-vitamins, with every dose on the label. EU orders ship from the brand's European depot in 4-12 working days (per performancelab.com's shipping page, checked 2026-10-05); we could not confirm a euro price.
whatItIs: Performance Lab Caffeine 2 is a stimulant capsule sold through performancelab.com. Each vegan pullulan capsule holds 50mg natural caffeine from Coffea robusta seeds, 100mg L-theanine, 250mg L-tyrosine and NutriGenesis vitamins B2, B6, folate and B12; a bottle holds 30 capsules. The label suggests 1-2 capsules on an empty stomach, up to a maximum of 5 capsules (250mg caffeine) a day. Per performancelab.com's shipping page (checked 2026-10-05), EU orders are shipped from the brand's depot in Europe; the page does not list individual EU countries, so confirm delivery to your country at checkout.
howItWorks: Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors, which dulls fatigue signals and raises alertness. L-theanine, an amino acid found in tea, is added at a 2:1 ratio to caffeine; Performance Lab cites human trials of theanine-plus-caffeine combinations for this pairing, but Caffeine 2 itself has not been tested in a published trial. L-tyrosine is a building block of dopamine and noradrenaline, and the vendor includes it to support the neurotransmitters that caffeine draws on. The four B-vitamins (B2, B6, folate, B12) supply 38-83% of the US Daily Value per capsule. Supplements sold in the EU fall under Directive 2002/46/EC, so the label may carry only EU-authorised health claims, and the EU register holds no authorised caffeine claim for alertness or concentration (a caffeine alertness claim was refused under Regulation (EU) 2016/1411).
whatToExpect: Performance Lab says Caffeine 2 starts working in around 15-30 minutes. One capsule gives 50mg caffeine; two capsules (100mg caffeine, 200mg L-theanine, 500mg L-tyrosine) bring all three actives into the ranges used in our dosing audit. Count it toward your daily caffeine intake. EU delivery is expected in 4-12 working days depending on destination (per performancelab.com's shipping page, checked 2026-10-05). We saw only US-dollar prices ($44 one-time for 30 capsules) when we checked, so confirm the euro total at checkout.
pros: Every dose disclosed on the label, no proprietary blend
Ships to EU buyers from a European depot (4-12 working days)
50mg caffeine per capsule lets you adjust intake in small steps (label maximum 5 a day)
cons: Only 50mg caffeine per capsule, below the 75mg low end of our caffeine range
L-tyrosine (250mg) sits below the 300-500mg range
No published trial of Caffeine 2 itself; the evidence is for its ingredients
Euro price not confirmed (only US-dollar prices seen on 2026-10-05)
Small Trustpilot sample: 14 reviews for performancelab.com (3.8/5, checked 2026-10-05)
30-day money-back guarantee covers the first order only: one container, used up, with the claim filed within 60 days of delivery, refund minus shipping

name: Pre Lab Pro
summary: A low-caffeine pre-workout drink powder from Performance Lab. One 13g scoop gives 80mg natural caffeine, 160mg L-theanine and 400mg L-tyrosine, all within the ranges in our dosing audit, plus a 2,200mg Setria for Sport blend (L-citrulline and glutathione, split not disclosed) and 1,500mg red beet powder that are unlikely to reach the doses used in performance trials. EU orders ship from the brand's European depot in 4-12 working days (per performancelab.com's shipping page, checked 2026-10-05); we could not confirm a euro price.
whatItIs: Pre Lab Pro is a natural-berry-flavoured pre-workout powder sold through performancelab.com; the buy buttons on its own site, prelabpro.com, link to that product page. A tub holds 20 servings of one 13g scoop, mixed into 300ml of water and taken 15-30 minutes before training, with no more than 2 scoops in 24 hours. Each scoop also supplies 500mg Himalayan pink salt, vitamin D3 from algae, B2, B6, folate, B12, potassium and iron. It is vegan, and the vendor states it is 'third-party tested and validated by Informed Sport'; the product page shows no certificate or batch number. EU orders are shipped from the brand's depot in Europe; the shipping page does not list individual EU countries, so confirm delivery to your country at checkout.
howItWorks: Caffeine (80mg) blocks adenosine receptors to dull fatigue signals, and L-theanine (160mg, a 2:1 ratio) plus L-tyrosine (400mg) are the nootropic trio from Performance Lab's Caffeine 2 capsule at higher amounts. L-citrulline is converted to arginine and then nitric oxide, and beetroot supplies dietary nitrate, a second nitric-oxide source; the vendor includes both for blood flow, strength and endurance. Glutathione, an antioxidant, makes up the rest of the Setria for Sport blend. Himalayan pink salt (200mg sodium) and potassium act as electrolytes. Pre Lab Pro itself has not been tested in a published trial; the vendor's claims rest on ingredient-level research. Supplements sold in the EU fall under Directive 2002/46/EC, so the label may carry only EU-authorised health claims, and the EU register holds no authorised caffeine claim for alertness or concentration (a caffeine alertness claim was refused under Regulation (EU) 2016/1411).
whatToExpect: Performance Lab says Pre Lab Pro starts working in around 15-30 minutes. The vendor calls the 80mg caffeine dose moderate, and two scoops (its 24-hour limit) give 160mg; count it toward your daily caffeine total. The citrulline and beet amounts are below the doses used in performance trials, so any blood-flow or endurance benefit from them is uncertain. EU delivery is expected in 4-12 working days depending on destination (per performancelab.com's shipping page, checked 2026-10-05). We saw only US-dollar prices ($59 one-time for 20 scoops) when we checked, so confirm the euro total at checkout.
pros: Caffeine, L-theanine and L-tyrosine all within our dosing-audit ranges
Vendor states Informed Sport testing, relevant to drug-tested athletes
Ships to EU buyers from a European depot (4-12 working days)
Vegan, naturally flavoured powder with electrolytes
cons: Only 20 scoops per tub ($2.95 a serving at the $59 one-time price); the vendor's monthly plan delivers one tub, so a scoop every day would need more than one tub a month
Setria for Sport blend (2,200mg) does not split L-citrulline and glutathione; even if it were all citrulline it would sit below the roughly 3g low end of citrulline trials
1.5g red beet powder with no stated nitrate content, very likely far below the roughly 6-8 mmol of nitrate used in beetroot trials
Several verified reviews on prelabpro.com report powder that set rock-hard in the tub; the company replied it had 'a bad batch' that was 'taken off sale' (checked 2026-10-05)

Strict 30-day guarantee: first order only, one tub, used up before claiming, refund minus shipping; performancelab.com allows claims within 60 days of delivery, but prelabpro.com's returns page says 30 days, so confirm the terms first
Euro price not confirmed (only US-dollar prices seen on 2026-10-05)
No published trial of Pre Lab Pro itself; the evidence is for its ingredients
